reviews.title: Ryzen 5 CPU is a very good starter CPU!
reviews.comment: Very good item, performance is good for medium games but only problem is the temperature gets too hot at times when playing certain games or when multiple windows are open, which is fine because this is a ryzen 5 which is meant for light gaming so good for starter CPU or just light gaming in general.
